2026_02_JAX_DEN.headline: Jacksonville’s passing momentum runs into Denver’s home-opening response
2026_02_JAX_DEN.paragraph1: Jacksonville reaches Denver at 1-0 with Trevor Lawrence and the passing game carrying momentum from a strong opener and a long winning stretch dating to last season. The Broncos are trying to answer a Week 1 loss in their home opener, but wide receiver Marvin Mims Jr. is out and running back RJ Harvey is questionable. Jacksonville must handle Denver’s pass rush and altitude; the Broncos need efficient early downs while replacing a major source of speed on offense.
2026_02_JAX_DEN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s pass protection against Denver’s pressure and the Broncos’ ability to manufacture explosives without Marvin Mims Jr. are the matchup’s clearest pressure areas.
